jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Backend .NET Senior
jobs_results.description:
En IT Partner estamos en la búsqueda de un/a desarrollador/a backend .NET Senior para un apasionante proyecto ubicado en Valencia. ¿Estás listo/a para un nuevo desafío en tu carrera profesional?

Tareas

Liderar y coordinar los desarrollos del equipo técnico asignado.

Resolver analizar y documentar las incidencias complejas que surjan en los proyectos.

Participar activamente en las reuniones tanto con el cliente como con el equipo aportando tu experiencia y conocimientos.

Supervisar y garantizar la calidad de las entregas asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de desarrollo.

Estimar y supervisar el tiempo y los recursos necesarios para los diferentes desarrollos o peticiones.

Coordinar y realizar despliegues a distintos entornos en los clientes asegurando una implementación exitosa.

Elaborar y mantener actualizada la documentación técnica del proyecto.

Mentorizar y formar a nuevos miembros del equipo compartiendo tus conocimientos y mejores prácticas.

Colaborar en la... mejora continua de los procesos de desarrollo de software.

Participar en la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones técnicas aportando tu experiencia y visión.

Trabajo 2 días desde la oficina y 3 en remoto (Valencia)

Requisitos

Experiencia mínima de 5 años en el desarrollo de tecnologías .NET incluyendo ASP.NET Framework C# ASP.NET Web Forms Spring.NET IoC container WebAPI Rest y web services SQL y Git.

Amplios conocimientos de patrones de programación como Herencia Polimorfismo Abstracción Encapsulamiento Factory Inyección de dependencias Inversión de Control.

Experiencia en pruebas unitarias y metodologías ágiles.

Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática o similar.

Requisitos Deseables

Experiencia avanzada con microservicios en .NET y Web API REST con ASP.NET Core > v3.1.

Dominio de ORM con Microsoft Entity Framework.

Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de arquitecturas escalables y resilientes.

Conocimientos avanzados en cache Redis u otros sistemas de cache clave-valor.

Experiencia en contenerización de APIs con Docker o containerd.

Experiencia con bases de datos NoSQL como MongoDB y bases de datos relacionales con Microsoft SQL Server.

Experiencia en el desarrollo y despliegue de aplicaciones en entornos de cloud (Azure AWS GCP).

Certificaciones relevantes en tecnologías .NET.

¿Crees que encajas con este perfil y estás listo/a para asumir este emocionante reto? ¡No dudes en enviarnos tu CV! Estamos ansiosos por conocer a un/a profesional como tú y trabajar juntos en este proyecto innovador.
• Net, ASP.Net, API Rest, .Net Core

jobs_results.description:
• Oportunidad de crecimiento profesional|SaaS internacional en pleno crecimiento

About Our Client

Nuestro cliente es una empresa SaaS enfocada al sector de las telecomunicaciones. Tienen un fuerte compromiso con la innovación y las nuevas tecnologías que aseguren la escalabilidad de su producto.

Job Description
• Desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones de back-end con Python y Django.
• Colaboración estrecha con el equipo de front-end para integrar las aplicaciones del lado del servidor.
• Participar en el diseño y desarrollo de la nueva arquitectura basada en microservicios.
• Mejorar la eficiencia del código y la usabilidad de las aplicaciones.
• Participar en la revisión de código y proporcionar retroalimentación constructiva.
• Asegurar la escalabilidad de producto manteniendo un alto % de cobertura.

The Successful Applicant
• Formación en Informática o campo relacionado.
• Al menos 3 años de experiencia con Python y Django.
• Conocimiento sólido de lenguajes de... programación, frameworks y bases de datos.
• Conocimiento de herramientas de testeo como Pytest.
• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y atención al detalle.
• Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y colaborar de manera efectiva con otros departamentos.
• Buena comprensión de las prácticas y principios de desarrollo de software.

What's on Offer
• Rango salarial entre 35K - 42K al año.
• Remoto: 60% (3 días en casa). Oficinas en BCN centro
• Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo de habilidades.
• Beneficios de salud y bienestar.
• Cultura empresarial centrada en la innovación y la mejora continua.

Contact: Josep Ferrer

Quote job ref: JN-032024-6374444

Brand: PP

jobs_results.description:
¿Te gusta trabajar de 9 a 18h en una oficina? ¿Sólo piensas en tu trabajo como un medio de vida? No sigas leyendo Este proyecto no es para ti.

Somos Mojito360, si, si has leído bien, Mojito ... y no, no somos una coctelería. Somos una empresa disruptiva en un sector muy serio. ¿Y qué hacemos? Ofrecemos el control del transporte de las mercancías a las grandes empresas.

¿Te suena el Atasco del Canal de Suez? Pues nosotros, durante esos días, fuimos lo más parecido a el Glovo de las mercancías , informábamos a nuestros clientes, en tiempo real, cuando podrían disponer de sus mercancías.

Si te gusta lo que oyes, esto es lo que ofrecemos:
• ¿Cómo te gusta trabajar? Teletrabajo completo, mixto o presencial, no nos importa cómo lo hagas si lo haces bien y con pasión.
• Estabilidad, contrato indefinido
• Nos importan las personas, estamos comprometidos en favorecer un entorno de trabajo libre de cualquier tipo de discriminación.
• ¿Quieres crecer con nosotros? Los límites te los pones... tú.
• Formación continua: Programas de formación y cursos
• Seguro médico
• Y el mejor ambiente de trabajo que te puedas imaginar ¿Qué buscamos?

Alguien con pasión, curiosidad y capacidad de aprendizaje

Que tenga conocimientos en:
• Conocimiento del lenguaje C#
• Conocimiento del lenguaje SQL Y si además ...

Tiene conocimientos en:
• De EntityFramework
• Azure
• GIT Con todo esto, si te ha gustado lo que has leído y tienes la pasión y los conocimientos, no lo dudes, escríbenos Queremos conocerte

jobs_results.title: Back-end developer
jobs_results.description:
Westcon-Comstor is looking for a Back-end developer (with Java experience) to join our Spanish team.

You can work remotely from any place in Spain on a flexible working schedule!

The main tasks:
• Design, develop, debug and troubleshoot new code and enhancements for business web application APIs following strict clean code policies and secure, clean design and approaches.
• Engage and collaborate with front-end developers, testers, devops and other parts of the team.
• Engage with users to gather and address design requirements.
• Provide training and support to internal teams.
• Follow and maintain knowledge of emerging technologies, integrated vendor APIs and our company business.

Required skills:
• English: Full professional proficiency. C1 desired; B2 an absolute minimum.
• Minimum 3 yr of real-world experience on backend development based on Java (Groovy and the Grails framework would be an asset).
• Expertise in object-oriented analysis, design and implementation, API first... security by default. Ability to make architectural decisions. Used to teams with a strict clean code policies, testing and code reviews.
• Knowledge of microservices architectures.
• Use of MySQL and good understanding of the SQL language.
• Past experience with GIT.
• Team player, self-driven, resourceful, committed and result-oriented.

Bonus skills (none required):
• Experience with cloud vendor APIs such as Microsoft Partner Center, AWS or Cisco PMI.
• Experience building e-commerce applications.
• RabbitMQ or a similar system.
• Build tools such as Gradle or Maven.
• Functional programming experience (Lisp, Haskell, etc).
• Good understanding of GNU/Linux or UNIX.

Join a growing global business!

Westcon-Comstor is a leading name in IT distribution. Our job is to link technology vendors to our distribution partners who resell software and solutions to business and other customers

jobs_results.description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Optimissa es una empresa de consultoría especializada en Financial Services, siempre en búsqueda permanente de los mayores entusiastas de la Consultoría. Intentamos reinventarnos constantemente para así poder ofrecer el mejor lugar para que nuestros colaboradores puedan desarrollar su carrera y la mejor alternativa como partner para nuestros clientes. Desarrolla tu carrera y escribe tu propia historia.

Nuestros Proyectos

Se caracterizan por un alto grado de complejidad, realizando labores de arquitectura, análisis y desarrollo. Construimos aplicaciones ad-hoc y producto propio para áreas de inversión de las principales entidades financieras.

En esta ocasión requerimos incorporar un Desarrollador Back-End con experiencia en SPARK, SCALA y Bash Script, para un importante cliente del sector bancario.

Requisitos:
• Grado en ingeniería informática o ingeniería técnica informática/Módulo superior en informática/desarrollo de aplicaciones.
• Conocimientos Hive.
•... Experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones batch/etl en spark, scala.
• Capacidad para desarrollar componentes reutilizables y modularizados.
• Experiencia trabajando en Git/GitHub, Jenkins, HUE, IntelliJ.
• Conocimientos de buenas prácticas de desarrollos, incluyendo pruebas.
• Capacidad para ser autónomo en toma de decisiones.
• Capacidad para trabajar eficazmente en un entorno de equipo
• Capacidad para transmitir claramente las ideas.

Ofrecemos:

-Incorporación estable

-Excelente ambiente de trabajo

-Plan de carrera profesional

-Salario negociable según experiencia

-Zona de trabajo: REMOTO 100% (Ubicación: ESPAÑA)

Si has seguido leyendo hasta aquí, cumples los requisitos....¡Únete a Optimissa

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
"I built my talents on the shoulders of someone else’s talent."

Michael Jordan

At Naiz Fit, we are excited to announce an incredible opportunity to join our team as a Senior Backend Developer. You will collaborate closely with the Technology team and report directly to the CTO.

We're looking for a talented, dedicated, and passionate software engineer to play a leading role in bringing our tools and infrastructure to the next level, contributing to the success and growth of the organization by effectively managing and advancing the technology aspects of the business.

We are looking for adventurers like you who want to be part of our expansion globally and make a lasting impact in the fashion industry.

Join the team and keep rocking it Naiz Style.
• What is Naiz Fit?

At the beginning of every story there is a once upon a time, some complicit glances and the must-have butterflies in your stomach, and to begin our story we would love to get you to know us a bit better.

The once... upon a time starts with a question: which is your size? We bet you had to answer that (and had no idea how to😉) at least once in your life while buying a new outfit.

That was our trigger when, 5 years ago, we were born to help the fashion industry to solve this question.

We had complicit glances with the first fashion brands which made us deeply understand the problem to build a solution for all of us, because brands and fashion lovers are in the same game. #YourBodyYourSize.

The magic (and butterflies) came when we unified the digital world with its data, and the creative art of fashion by trying the collections of the brands who want to solve their sizing issues on real people with different body types.

Because fashion is way more than a bunch of numbers.

We are partners in crime with brands to create an industry where all body types will find their perfect fit.

Our story started as a digital solution for ecommerce to assist buyers while choosing sizes.

That was the beginning of an adventure that brought us to today, now we are part of MySize Inc group, a Nasdaq listed company, and we are helping fashion brands with solutions for ecommerce, retail and product departments to address size&fit issues with ad hoc solutions for every step of the value chain.
• Our clients

At Naiz Fit, our clients are the heart of our focus. We are committed to delivering exceptional service tailored to their unique needs. To give you a better idea, here are a few examples of the variety of clients we work with.

Key Responsibilities:

We are looking for someone who will not just be able to understand and continue the work we have been doing, but someone that is also capable of bringing a new perspective and that might be able to point out what and where we can improve.

You will be responsible for:
• Architect and develop scalable backend services:
• As a key contributor, you will play a crucial role in shaping and building our technological infrastructure.
• Your responsibilities include envisioning and crafting scalable backend service architectures that serve as the foundation for our innovative products.
• Additionally, you'll take charge of evolving existing legacy services, employing your expertise to enhance scalability and stability in our dynamic and ever-evolving environment.
• Mastering the skill of coding in adherence to clean architecture principles, ensuring a well-organized, modular, and maintainable software design.

Skills and experience:
• You have 5+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on backend systems.
• Experience in SCALA or JAVA is a plus but not mandatory. We are open to a wide variety of backend ecosystems like PHP, Python, JS, NodeJS
• Experience in relational and non-relational databases like MySQL, MongoDB.
• We utilize event-based software architectures and asynchronous messaging, leveraging Kafka and RabbitMQ technology, to enhance the efficiency and responsiveness of our software solutions.
• Proficiency in the Agile framework, fostering team collaboration and maintaining a focus on scalability and stability.
• Proactive mindset and a sense of ownership towards the source code.
• You’re structured and creative enough to solve most challenging problems independently, given the necessary knowledge. You learn new concepts and skills rapidly.
• Willingness to learn. You keep pace with the ever-evolving tech world, always updating your skills and knowledge.
• You are highly communicative, able to work with cross- functional teams...
• You have strong communication skills, both in English and Spanish.

The selection process

The selection process consists of three stages. First, a brief catch-up interview with the People Lead, followed by a second interview with the CTO. Successful candidates will then be invited to complete a business case to assess their technical abilities.

The final stage involves a cultural check interview with a company colleague.

Why would you love to join us?

🌍 Remote friendly culture. We're 100% remote . We have offices in San Sebastián, Madrid and Barcelona.

👍 Flexible schedules that work with your life. Freedom environment, which entails responsibility.

✅ Career development, including English language classes.

🔝 We are getting bigger but we still have a start-up feeling.

⚡ A key position in the company where you can see your impact on the business from the very beginning.

🖖 We believe in autonomy and taking initiative.

👫 We cultivate a positive work culture that supports personal and professional growth; we are all part of the same project, and we are passionate about it.

🤩 Employee engagement activities and quarterly work retreats.

Our Values

✭ Ask for forgiveness, not permission

🎯 Embrace Uniqueness

👫 Team of Minions

💫 Enjoy the ride

If you are excited about everything that you have just read... Join us!

—----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To prove our culture, we leave you here a talk given by our CEO, Borja Cembrero, which we believe represents our culture very well.
• Disclaimer, it is in Spanish 🇪🇸
• We have crossed out the words artificial intelligence because we are tired of so much big words in the tech world. We solve a problem, which is THE important thing. But if you join us, we'll explain you all the details about how we solve it

The magic (and butterflies) came when we unified the digital world with its data, and the creative art of fashion by trying the collections of the brands who want to solve their sizing issues on real people with different body types.

Because fashion is way more than a bunch of numbers.

We are partners in crime with brands to create an industry where all body types will find their perfect fit.

Our story started as a digital solution for ecommerce to assist buyers while choosing sizes.

That was the beginning of an adventure that brought us to today, now we are part of MySize Inc group, a Nasdaq listed company, and we are helping fashion brands with solutions for ecommerce, retail and product departments to address size&fit issues with ad hoc solutions for every step of the value chain.
• Our clients

At Naiz Fit, our clients are the heart of our focus. We are committed to delivering exceptional service tailored to their unique needs. To give you a better idea, here are a few examples of the variety of clients we work with.

Key Responsibilities:

We are looking for someone who will not just be able to understand and continue the work we have been doing, but someone that is also capable of bringing a new perspective and that might be able to point out what and where we can improve.

You will be responsible for:
• Architect and develop scalable backend services:
• As a key contributor, you will play a crucial role in shaping and building our technological infrastructure.
• Your responsibilities include envisioning and crafting scalable backend service architectures that serve as the foundation for our innovative products.
• Additionally, you'll take charge of evolving existing legacy services, employing your expertise to enhance scalability and stability in our dynamic and ever-evolving environment.
• Mastering the skill of coding in adherence to clean architecture principles, ensuring a well-organized, modular, and maintainable software design.

Skills and experience:
• You have 5+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on backend systems.
• Experience in SCALA or JAVA is a plus but not mandatory. We are open to a wide variety of backend ecosystems like PHP, Python, JS, NodeJS
• Experience in relational and non-relational databases like MySQL, MongoDB.
• We utilize event-based software architectures and asynchronous messaging, leveraging Kafka and RabbitMQ technology, to enhance the efficiency and responsiveness of our software solutions.
• Proficiency in the Agile framework, fostering team collaboration and maintaining a focus on scalability and stability.
• Proactive mindset and a sense of ownership towards the source code.
• You’re structured and creative enough to solve most challenging problems independently, given the necessary knowledge. You learn new concepts and skills rapidly.
• Willingness to learn. You keep pace with the ever-evolving tech world, always updating your skills and knowledge.
• You are highly communicative, able to work with cross- functional teams...
• You have strong communication skills, both in English and Spanish.

The selection process

The selection process consists of three stages. First, a brief catch-up interview with the People Lead, followed by a second interview with the CTO. Successful candidates will then be invited to complete a business case to assess their technical abilities.

The final stage involves a cultural check interview with a company colleague.

Why would you love to join us?

🌍 Remote friendly culture. We're 100% remote . We have offices in San Sebastián, Madrid and Barcelona.

👍 Flexible schedules that work with your life. Freedom environment, which entails responsibility.

✅ Career development, including English language classes.

🔝 We are getting bigger but we still have a start-up feeling.

⚡ A key position in the company where you can see your impact on the business from the very beginning.

🖖 We believe in autonomy and taking initiative.

👫 We cultivate a positive work culture that supports personal and professional growth; we are all part of the same project, and we are passionate about it.

🤩 Employee engagement activities and quarterly work retreats.

Our Values

✭ Ask for forgiveness, not permission

🎯 Embrace Uniqueness

👫 Team of Minions

💫 Enjoy the ride

If you are excited about everything that you have just read... Join us!

—----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To prove our culture, we leave you here a talk given by our CEO, Borja Cembrero, which we believe represents our culture very well.
• Disclaimer, it is in Spanish 🇪🇸
• We have crossed out the words artificial intelligence because we are tired of so much big words in the tech world. We solve a problem, which is THE important thing. But if you join us, we'll explain you all the details about how we solve it

jobs_results.description:
ʙᴀᴄᴋᴇɴᴅ ᴅᴇᴠᴇʟᴏᴘᴇʀ @ ʙʟᴜᴇᴛʜʀᴏɴᴇ

🌍 ʀᴇᴍᴏᴛᴇ, ᴡᴏʀᴋ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ᴀɴʏᴡʜᴇʀᴇ 🌏

About BlueThrone

Embark on a transformative journey with BlueThrone, a pioneer in the mobile app domain. We specialize in turning promising B2C mobile apps into market leaders, boasting over 49.5 million organic downloads and 4.6 million monthly active users.

With a mission to propel iOS and Android applications to new heights, we've achieved a remarkable ARR ᴏʀɢᴀɴɪᴄᴀʟʟʏ in just 25 months, exemplifying sustainable growth and innovation. Our team, rich in tech entrepreneurship and mobile marketing expertise, thrives in an environment that values... agility, a growth mindset, flexibility, creativity, and tangible outcomes.

𝘈𝘵 𝘉𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘛𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘯𝘦, 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘤𝘢𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘯 𝘢 𝘫𝘰𝘣—𝘪𝘵'𝘴 𝘢 𝘫𝘰𝘶𝘳𝘯𝘦𝘺 𝘵𝘰𝘸𝘢𝘳𝘥𝘴 𝘦𝘹𝘤𝘦𝘭𝘭𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘦 𝘪𝘯 𝘢𝘯 𝘪𝘯𝘯𝘰𝘷𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘤𝘶𝘭𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘸𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘩𝘪𝘨𝘩 𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘦 𝘪𝘴 𝘢𝘴 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘯𝘰𝘷𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯

The Opportunity

Dive into a groundbreaking role at the forefront of the music insights revolution. Our platform, celebrated for its pioneering approach to music analytics, connects users to music on a deeper level, evidenced by over 12 million downloads. This isn't just about software; it's about creating a community united by music.

As a ʙᴀᴄᴋᴇɴᴅ ᴅᴇᴠᴇʟᴏᴘᴇʀ specializing in ɴᴏᴅᴇ.ᴊꜱ and ᴛʏᴘᴇᴅᴄʀɪᴘᴛ, you will engineer the backbone of our leading music analytics platform. This position involves more than writing code; it's about building a robust foundation that powers seamless user experiences and enables expansive growth in our market reach.

Your Mission
• Design and implement scalable backend systems that support complex data operations and user interactions.
• Performance Optimization: Utilize ɴᴏᴅᴇ.ᴊꜱ and ᴛʏᴘᴇᴅᴄʀɪᴘᴛ to enhance system efficiency and handle increasing loads with minimal latency.
• Work alongside frontend developers, designers, and product managers to create holistic solutions that align with business objectives.
• Address technical challenges with innovative solutions that not only improve functionality but also contribute to the strategic goals of the company.
• Navigate through fast-paced project landscapes, employing agile frameworks to deliver scalable and robust solutions efficiently.

Your Expedition Toolkit
• 5 years of ʙᴀᴄᴋᴇɴᴅ ᴅᴇᴠᴇʟᴏᴘᴇᴍᴇɴᴛ experience with a strong portfolio of projects demonstrate your skill in ɴᴏᴅᴇ.ᴊꜱ, ᴛʏᴘᴇᴅᴄʀɪᴘᴛ and high-load backend service Development.
• Strong knowledge of ɴɢɪɴx and ᴅᴇᴠᴏᴘꜱ for effective infrastructure management.
• Comprehensive knowledge of databases (ᴘᴏꜱᴛɢʀᴇꜱQʟ, ᴇʟᴀꜱᴛɪᴄꜱᴇᴀʀᴄʜ), messaging systems (ʀᴀʙʙɪᴛᴍQ), and caching mechanisms (ʀᴇᴅɪꜱ).
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ᴀɢɪʟᴇ environment where quick iterations and feedback are a norm, and utilizing tools like ᴊɪʀᴀ for project tracking.
• Qᴜᴀʟɪᴛʏ ᴀꜱꜱᴜʀᴀɴᴄᴇ Expertise with focus on enhancing refining testing processes, ensuring code quality, and upholding accessibility and standard methodologies.
• Some experience with ᴍᴏʙɪʟᴇ Development technologies like ꜰʟᴜᴛᴛᴇʀ and ᴋᴏᴛʟɪɴ is a strong advantage.
• Excellent verbal and written ᴄᴏᴍᴍᴜɴɪᴄᴀᴛɪᴏɴ ꜱᴋɪʟʟꜱ to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to stakeholders.
• Professional Proficiency in ᴇɴɢʟɪꜱʜ language. Knowledge of ʀᴜꜱꜱɪᴀɴ and ʜᴇʙʀᴇᴡ Languages is a nice to have.

Why Join BlueThrone?

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Work from Anywhere: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

🌍 Global Reach: Work with a diverse team of 50 exceptional talents spread across over 19 countries, expanding your professional network and cultural understanding.

Ready to embark on a journey with BlueThrone? Apply Now

jobs_results.title: Back-End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Hola 👋

Accountali somos una empresa de software contable para vendedores en Amazon. En un mundo donde más del 50% de los vendedores eligen Amazon como su plataforma de ventas, la gestión de la contabilidad se ha convertido en una tarea abrumadora. En Accountali, hemos tomado la delantera al crear un software que se sincroniza directamente con Amazon, ofreciendo una solución automatizada para simplificar y agilizar el proceso contable.

Con sede en Mataró, contamos con un equipo experto en contabilidad, marketplace y tecnología con un claro objetivo: queremos que los vendedores en Amazon cumplan con la normativa contable de manera sencilla. Estamos en pleno crecimiento y, por ello, buscamos un nuevo miembro para nuestro equipo, que sea parte de esta expansión y sigamos simplificando juntos la gestión financiera de miles de vendedores en Amazon.

En Accountali, destacamos la innovación, la calidad y la excelencia en todas nuestras actividades. Contamos con un equipo de profesionales... altamente capacitados y apasionados por la tecnología y el análisis de datos, y nos encantaría que te unieras a nosotros. Cultivamos un entorno de trabajo colaborativo y creativo, donde se impulsa el crecimiento profesional y se fomenta la creatividad.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a desarrollador/a Back End proactivo/a, entusiasta por contribuir con sus conocimientos y experiencia.

Tus tareas serán...
• Mejorar y ampliar las funcionalidades actuales de Accountali
• Diseñar test para las funciones actuales y futuras de Accountali
• Diseñar nuevas funcionalidades usando Typescript en el framework Nest.js de Node.js
• Diseñar y mantener estructuras de datos en MongoDB
• Usar APIs de Amazon para recolectar datos, tratarlos y guardarlos
• Crear colas de trabajo

Esto es para ti si tienes…
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia trabajando con NodeJs y Typescript
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia trabajando con MongoDB
• Conocimientos de herramientas de testeo de Node.js
• Valorables conocimientos en Nest.js
• Valorables conocimientos en BullMQ
• Valorables conociminetos de Analisis de Datos
• Valorables conocimientos en Machine Learning y Inteligencia Artificial
• Valorables conocimientos de Docker
• Valorables conocimientos de Apis de Amazon
• Valorables conocimientos de Sistemas Cloud en AWS

Te ofrecemos...
• Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico y desafiante
• Oportunidad de desarrollar habilidades técnicas y contribuir directamente al éxito de nuestra plataforma
• Flexibilidad y opciones de trabajo en remoto
• Un salario basado en tu experiencia y tu contribución
• Un contrato indefinido
• Un equipo joven, internacional, abierto y dinámico
• Dos días trabajo en la oficina y tres días en remoto
• Un plan de formación en un nuevo sector que está en alza
• Visión internacional
• Café gratis

Si estás en la búsqueda de unirte a un equipo talentoso y comprometido, te invitamos a aplicar a esta emocionante oportunidad en Accountali. ¡Esperamos con entusiasmo recibir tu solicitud y conocerte pronto
